text:
Your de-Googling website is now live! 🚀

**Project created with:**
- ✅ Astro (static site generator)
- ✅ React (for interactive components)
- ✅ TypeScript (type safety)
- ✅ Tailwind CSS (modern styling)

**Website features:**
- Modern dark theme design
- Hero section explaining de-Googling
- Service alternatives page (Gmail → ProtonMail, Search → DuckDuckGo, etc.)
- Practical tips for reducing Google dependency
- Responsive layout with Tailwind styling

**View your site at:** http://localhost:4321/

The development server is running and will auto-reload when you make changes. Navigate to `/alternatives` and `/tips` to see all the content!
